LanguageData.AquacultureFishing.TraitSettingsExplanat: Wild exceptional traits and new offspring mutations roll separately. Each eligible parental trait rolls independently; a trait present in both parents has a 1.5x inheritance chance. The inherited-trait cap is applied after successful rolls. Registered-breed reliability is the breed stability multiplied by its reliability setting, so low-stability breeds do not guarantee defining traits.
